kdc.description: Configuration options for the Heimdal KDC service

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections

database.description: Path to the KDC database file

realm.description: Kerberos realm name (e.g., EXAMPLE.COM). Leave empty to auto-detect

listen_addresses.description: List of IP addresses or hostnames on which the KDC will listen

port.description: UDP port for Kerberos KDC requests

tcp_port.description: TCP port for Kerberos KDC requests

enable_pkinit.description: Enable PKINIT support (public key cryptography for initial authentication)

keytab.description: Path to the KDC service keytab file

tgt_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime for Ticket Granting Ticket (TGT) in seconds

ticket_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime for regular tickets in seconds

renewable_lifetime.description: Maximum renewable lifetime for tickets in seconds

clockskew.description: Maximum allowed clock skew in seconds between client and KDC

pkinit_identity.description: Path to PKCS#12 file (or equivalent) containing the KDC’s certificate and private key for PKINIT

acl.description: Access control list rules (one per line, in 'principal = permissions' format)

items.description: ACL rule in format: principal = [list, of, permissions]

policy.description: Per-principal policy definitions: map of principal name to {min_lifetime, max_lifetime, max_renewable}
